newsitem.title: RUSSIA: At least 11 die in Russian office building blast.
newsitem.headline: At least 11 die in Russian office building blast.

text.p: At least 11 people died and 19 were injured on Monday when a powerful explosion destroyed a two-storey office building in a remote Russian settlement, a spokeswoman for the emergency ministry said.
The explosion, which was believed to have been caused by a kitchen gas canister, took place near the town of Kueda, 250 km (155 miles) south of the regional centre of Perm in the Urals.

The spokeswoman said six survivors had suffered serious injuries and about 10 people were feared missing in the debris. Itar-Tass news agency said most of the residents of the settlement worked at a small oil refinery.
Local emergency crews rushed to the scene and backup teams from the emergencies ministry were expected to be sent from Moscow later in the day.
